questions.topic: Basis and dimension of a subspace
questions.md:
Let $W$ be the subspace of $\mathbb{R}^4$ spanned by the set of vectors $\{(1,2,0,1), (2,1,0,3), (3,1,2,4)\}$.

(i) Find a basis and the dimension of $W$.

(ii) Extend the basis of $W$ to a basis of $\mathbb{R}^4$.

questions.topic: Basis and dimension of a subspace
questions.md:
Find a basis and the dimension of the solution space $W$ of the homogeneous system of equations:

$$x + 2y - z + s + t = 0;$$
$$-x - 2y + 2z + t = 0;\quad -x - 2y + 3z + s + 3t = 0.$$

Consider the following subspaces of $\mathbb{R}^3$: $U = \operatorname{Span}\{(1,0,1), (0,1,1)\}$ and $W = \operatorname{Span}\{(1,1,0), (1,2,1)\}$.

Find the dimension of $U + W$ and $U \cap W$.

Let $W_1, W_2$ be the subspaces of $\mathbb{R}^4$ given as $W_1 = \{(a,b,c,d) \mid b - 2c + d = 0\}$ and $W_2 = \{(a,b,c,d) \mid a = d,\ b = 2c\}$. Find a basis and the dimension of

(i) $W_1 \cap W_2$

(ii) $W_1 + W_2$.

Let $W_1, W_2$ be the subspaces of $\mathbb{R}^3$ given as follows: $W_1 = \{(a,b,c) \mid c = 0\}$ and $W_2 = \{(a,b,c) \mid a - 4b + c = 0\}$. Find a basis and the dimension of $W_1 \cap W_2$ and $W_1 + W_2$.
